announcements.headline: Half Year Trading Update
announcements.insight: As a niche investment trust focused on the UK housing market, this update provides critical visibility into developer liquidity and land bank valuation pressures during a high-interest-rate environment, directly influencing investor sentiment on PEABODY's underlying asset quality.

announcements.headline: Departure of Chief Operating Officer
announcements.insight: The departure of a Chief Operating Officer represents a significant executive change that may impact operational continuity and strategic execution. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent announcements regarding interim leadership arrangements or the recruitment process.

announcements.headline: Unaudited results for the year ended 31 March 2026
announcements.insight: As a listed property investment vehicle, this annual results release is critical for validating the valuation of its UK affordable housing portfolio amidst current interest rate and construction cost pressures.
